translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Yesu iyoulapula baisa tailima taiyu toligalega
Oluvi, Yesu iyomitali titoulela baisa toligalega okawolawala Milaveta Taibiria;
e iyomitali titoulela baisa makawala.
Isidadailisi Saimoni Pita, Tomasi idokaisi yagala Nupoyu, Nataniela guma Kena
mapilana Galili, Sebedi litula
toyo taiyu la toligalega tuwoli.
Saimoni Pita iluki matausina, kawala, “Bala apoula.” Ilukwaisi matauna, kawasi, “Yakamaisi deli bitalosi.” E ilosi, isilasi wa waga e ipwapoulasi; e bogi makwaina komwaidona inanotasi wala.
Obulubuvisiga Yesu itotu okawolawa; mitaga toligalega gala ivitusaisi kidamwa matauna Yesu.
Yesu ikatupoi matausina, kawala, “Tauwau, kwalaisi? Gala sitana kukwalotasi ke?” Ivitakaulokaisi matauna, kawasi, “Gala wala.”
Iluki matausina, kawala, “Kulavaisi wota okatalela waga, e bukukolaisi.” Mapaila ilavaisi, e gala gagabila bibiaisi paila yena saina bidugaga.
Mapaila matauna toligalega tombwailila Yesu iluki Pita, kawala, “Matauna Guyau goli.” Tutala Saimoni Pita ilagi mwada matauna Guyau, isikam kala kakapula, paila leivilili miyana, e ivabusi obolita.
Mitaga toligalega kesala isududilasi si waga, ibiaisi wota ikalulusewa yena; paila waga gala kaduwonaku mitaga kala maloula kaina makawala kwaiyu baleku.
E bogwa ivalaguvasi, igisaisi pwakova baisa, e yena ikanukwenusi makovana deli kaula.
Yesu iluki matausina, kawala, “Kumaiyaisi sitana yena lokukolaisi.”
Mapaila Saimoni Pita isila e ibia wota imai okawolawa, leikalulusewa yena navakaveka kala bawa lakatutala naluwolima natolu; makawala goli kala bawa mitaga wota gala ikobolusi.
Yesu iluki matausina, kawala, “Kumaisi; kukwatumataisi kami molu.” E gala taitala toligalega ituvaluwa bikatupoi matauna, “Availa yoku?” Inikolaisi matauna Guyau.
Yesu ima, ikau kaula isaiki matausina, e yena makawala.
Baisa sivitolula Yesu iyomitali titoulela baisa toligalega, tutala eitokaia imovavau.
Kuvakoma ulo sipi
E bogwa ikatumataisi kasi molu, Yesu iluki Saimoni Pita, kawala, “Saimoni, Yoni latula, kuyebwailigu sainela, e vavagi makwaisina sitana wala ke?”
Iluki matauna, kawala, “Mitaga, Guyau, kunikoli ayebwailim.” Yesu iluki matauna, kawala, “Kuvakoma minasina ulo lam.”
Siviyuwela iluki matauna, kawala, “Saimoni, Yoni latula, kuyebwailigu ke.” Iluki matauna, kawala, “Mitaga, Guyau, kunikoli ayebwailim.” Iluki matauna, kawala, “Kuyamati minasina ulo sipi.”

Iluki matauna sivitolula, kawala, “Saimoni, Yoni latula, kuyebwailigu ke?” Pita nanola ikaikai paila leikaibiga sivitolula baisa matauna, kawala, “Kuyebwailigu ke?” E iluki matauna, kawala, “Guyau, kunikoli vavagi komwaidona; kunikoli ayebwailim.” Yesu iluki matauna, kawala, “Kuvakoma minasina ulo sipi.
Biga mokwita alukwaim, om tuta gwadi, kupali kam kwarekwa e kuliloula ambaisa magim goli; mitaga tutala bukutomoya, bukuvitukoli yamam, e taitala tuwoli bipalaim e bilauwaim ambaisa gala magim.”
Ililivala baisa kidamwa bivitububoti ammakawala Pita bivigaki Yaubada kala yakaula metoya ola kaliga.
E bogwa ilivala baisa, iluki matauna, kawala, “Kubokulaigu.”
Toligalega Yesu tombwailila
Pita itovila, igisi toligalega matauna, tombwailila Yesu, ililoula oluvi; baisa matauna goli leisividuli Yesu okamkwam, e kawala, “Tomoya, availa matauwena bikasalaim?”
Tutala Pita igisi matauwena, ikatupoi Yesu, kawala, “Guyau, ammakawala matauwena?”
Yesu iluki matauna, kawala, “Kidamwa yeigu adoki bisisu igau tutala bama, baisa gala m vavagi yoku. Yoku kubokulaigu!”

Mapaila biga mabigana iyoyu baisa kala tobwakuli Yesu kidamwa toligalega matauna gala bikaliga. Mitaga Yesu gala ilivala mwada toligalega matauna gala bikaliga; mitaga ilivala, kawala, “Kidamwa yeigu adoki bisisu igau tutala bama, baisa gala m vavagi yoku.”
Baisa goli matauna toligalega isilasola paila vavagi makwaisina, e leigini vavagi makwaisina; e kanikolaisi leikamokwita la silasola.
Mitaga Yesu leivagi bidubadu vavagi tuvaila; e kidamwa bitaginisi kwaitala kwaitala vavagi makwaisina bikaloubusisi buki bidubadu, e adoki buki mpasina bikasuwoki valu watanawa e bigugulomgwa.

footnotes.text: Baisa igiyuwela Milaveta Galili (kugisi Yn 6.1 kala katumiki).
Mina Kavataria idokaisi baisa kala maloula makawala okawolawa bila obulobula.

kuyebwailigu sainela, e vavagi makwaisina sitana wala ke? Gagabila bitagini, “kuyebwailigu sainela, e matausina sitana wala ke?’ kainaga, “kuyebwailigu sainela e matausina kuyebwaili sitana wala ke?”.
Yesu ikibuboti Pita igau bikatumataisi wala.
